# RTD ramps up transit this weekend for major events across downtown

Share

Customers are encouraged to use bus and rail services to easily reach high-volume events

DENVER (Sept. 3, 2026) –– The Regional Transportation District (RTD)is preparing for large downtown events Friday through Sunday, including Garth Brooks concerts at Ball Arena, and the Colorado Rockies hosting the St. Louis Cardinals at Coors Field.
